request: 你看看有没有还能加日志和异常分析检测的地方，这样后面会非常好分析，在额外加一个功能，会话数据流dump，用于分析会话调用和工具调用状态
acceptance: Add a downloadable, authenticated per-session/per-run dataflow dump that records provider request lifecycle, tool dispatch/result state, persisted execution-journal events, related incident metadata, and bounded anomaly findings.

Keep dump content-free by default: no prompts, model messages, provider request bodies, tool arguments/results, secrets, or host paths; include counts, byte lengths, digests only where safe, timestamps, statuses, IDs, and structured error classifications.
Preserve existing debug authentication/auditing and bound journal reads/output; do not change runtime session data or existing diagnostic authorization defaults.
Document the endpoint and explain which existing logs are reused and what anomaly checks are derived.
scope: internal/server/execution_journal.go (only if required to share safe journal parsing)

requirements.summary: Define an authenticated, content-free per-run dataflow download that combines provider calls, execution journal, tool state, incidents, and derived anomaly findings.
evidence: Acceptance criteria preserve the debug token/audit policy and exclude raw prompts, provider bodies, tool args/results, secrets, and host paths.

design.summary: Add GET /api/debug/sessions/{id}/runs/{run}/dataflow; reuse persisted request snapshots, execution-events JSONL, and linked incidents. Persist provider outcome/error classification; report only counts, byte lengths, timestamps, enums, and anonymized call refs.
evidence: Existing request snapshots and execution journal are already correlated to run/session IDs.
Journal reads bounded to 64 MiB and 5000 events; dump contains no message/request/tool payload.

implementation.summary: Added dataflow JSON download, chronological timeline, content-safe projections, provider success/failure/empty-response metadata, and detection for incomplete calls, missing tool results, unresolved intents, journal gaps/corruption, and linked error incidents. Updated Chinese and English API docs.
evidence: Added internal/server/debug_dataflow.go and route in internal/server/server.go.
Provider outcome metadata recorded in internal/server/workflow.go, internal/server/conversation_parallel.go, internal/server/provider_image.go, and RequestSnapshot in internal/server/context.go.

verification.summary: 认证、会话数据流导出和内容脱敏单元测试通过；服务端定向测试、Race 检测、vet 和二进制构建通过。

documentation.summary: Documented the endpoint, payload redaction, limits, anomaly checks, and curl download in Chinese and English; updated diagnostics architecture notes.

cleanup.summary: Kept all prior untracked task files untouched; added only this task record and the implementation/docs files in scope. No runtime state or session data changed.
evidence: git status --short reviewed; pre-existing task files docs/tasks/terminal-display-settings-20261103.json and docs/tasks/terminal-log-read-api-release-20261103.json were left untouched.

release.summary: 代码纳入当前 main 提交并待推送；运行中的 Aide 服务镜像未更新。

rollback: Revert the new endpoint, handler, docs, and task record; no data migration or session-data rewrite.
